text:
Ana S: Heads-up — Concord pilot kickoff tomorrow. Need to lock POC success criteria and golden prompts today. EOD would be ideal.
Michael S: Quick recap of scope — primary flow is invoice ingestion -> retrieval -> LLM Q&A + field extraction for AP team. Secondary is conversational clarifications.
Jamie R: For the golden set I'm thinking: 150 invoices (mix PDF/CSV, noisy OCR) + 40 human Q&A pairs tied to business rules. We should include edge-case invoices (multi-page, multiple currencies).
Priya D: For the eval harness, suggest separating: unit prompts (field extraction), conversational prompts (Q&A), and adversarial set for hallucination tests.
Priya D: Example scoring config I want to run locally then seed into the harness:
```
{
  "scorers": [
    {"name":"entity_f1","weight":0.5},
    {"name":"answer_exact_match","weight":0.3},
    {"name":"hallucination_rate","weight":0.2}
  ],
  "thresholds": {"pass": 0.82, "warn": 0.75}
}
```
Jamie R: That looks good. Suggest entity_f1 computed per-field with a per-field minimum (e.g., invoice_number 0.95, total_amount 0.9).
Michael S: Timeline constraints from Concord: 2-week POC, live demo week 2. So baseline eval + one regression run must happen by day 8 to iterate.
Ana S: Pricing question came up — Concord expects an estimate for both hosted usage and a Dedicated pilot. FinanceBot, can you drop a ballpark?
FinanceBot: Ballpark for 30k tokens/day (hosted): ~$3k/month metered. Dedicated small pool (reserved GPUs, 4 vGPU eq): ~$18k/month + onboarding. Final quote depends on SLAs and retention.
Matt L: Security checklist items from Concord: SSO (SAML/SCIM), data-in-transit encryption, customer-managed KMS for Private, retention controls, and SOC2 evidence. They also flagged cross-account log access for auditing.
Ana S: Action items — Jamie to assemble golden seed (deadline: today, EOD), Priya to commit scoring config to harness and run baseline (deadline: day 3), Matt to share QA answers and necessary controls doc (tomorrow).
Jamie R: I'll upload a first tranche to s3: s3://concord-poc/goldenset/seed_v1.jsonl and post link here when done.
Priya D: Seeding command I'll use for the harness: `redwood eval seed --input s3://concord-poc/goldenset/seed_v1.jsonl --project concord-poc --scorer scoring_v1`
Michael S: Regression gate proposal: require overall pass >= 0.82 AND no critical-field drop > 5% relative to baseline. If gate fails, fallback to smaller model + human-in-loop for demo.
Ana S: Concord also asked about turnaround for security Qs — Matt, can you confirm if we can return answers within 48 hours?
Matt L: Yes, 48 hours for standard questionnaire. For bespoke infra questions might be 3–5 business days.
Jamie R: Done — uploaded first 50 invoices and 10 Q&A pairs. Link: s3://concord-poc/goldenset/seed_v1.jsonl :thumbsup:
Priya D: Running baseline now, will post summary (precision/recall/F1 + hallucination rate) in this thread when complete.
Ana S: Great. We'll sync tomorrow 10am PT to review baseline and pick the demo prompts.
Michael S: Agreed. Thanks all.
Matt L: Adding note — we'll need a short A/V slide on data handling for the demo. I'll draft.
FinanceBot: Quote placeholder created: PROD-QUOTE-23902 (internal).
Ana S: Perfect, closing loop here. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :rocket:
